newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seesaw, end up on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seesaw, end up on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks inched up at Monday's close on buying of blue chips by foreign investors, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.

The Karachi 100-index ended higher after rising in early trading and falling at midsession, a dealer of Fortune Securities said. The index ended 0.23 point, or 0.01 percent, up at 1,585.67, after rising to 1,592.83 in early trade and falling to 1,579 at about noon. Losers led gainers 158 to 94.
Pakistan State Oil rose 5.0 to 332, Lever Brothers 5.0 to 785 and Shell Pakistan 2.0 to 239 at close at 14.15 p.m. (0915 GMT). -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
